_about.source: NERC Compliance Tracker (Copy) artifact, standards collection, read 2026-11-05. CGM reference content; no client data.
_about.fields: recur.n = interval (0 = event-driven, no repeat); recur.unit d=days, m=calendar months, y=calendar years (due Dec 31 of the year N years later). suggestedBasis comes from the artifact's BASIS_SUGGEST table and is NOT confirmed by CGM: 'done' = interval runs from completion date, 'due' = fixed schedule from previous due date. url empty = default https://www.nerc.com/pa/Stand/Reliability%20Standards/<CODE>-<VERSION>.pdf
_about.caveat: Versions reflect the library as loaded in October 2026; the artifact itself says to confirm each version against NERC U.S. effective dates. Not re-verified here.
